args.title: checkout-api health checks failing after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary:
checkout-api began failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) following the latest deploy of v2.3.1, with an error rate of ~18%.

Actions taken:
1. Verified current state: all regions on v2.3.1, unhealthy, error rate 0.18.
2. Reviewed release history and identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 also healthy; v2.3.1 unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc unhealthy but staging-only).
3. Initiated rollback to v2.3.0. The first attempt partially failed (rollout halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error), leaving us-east on v2.3.0 and us-west/eu-west on v2.3.1.
4. Retried the rollback, which completed successfully across all regions.

Current state: all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are on v2.3.0. Service health checks are passing and error rate has returned to ~0.2%.

Note: v2.3.1 remains the version to investigate before any redeploy; v2.3.1-rc is also marked unhealthy in staging. No deploy of a never-before-healthy version was performed, so no change-manager approval was required.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident did go through despite the timeout — INC-0001 exists and is open, so no retry was needed.

## Summary

**Rollback completed.** checkout-api is healthy again in all production regions.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Initial state | v2.3.1 in us-east/us-west/eu-west, unhealthy, 18% error rate |
| Target version | **v2.3.0** — most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 also healthy; v2.3.1 unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc unhealthy but staging-only) |
| Rollback attempt 1 | Partial failure — orchestrator error halted rollout after us-east (us-east→v2.3.0, us-west/eu-west still on v2.3.1) |
| Rollback attempt 2 | Success — v2.3.0 in all three regions |
| Final state | v2.3.0 everywhere, healthy: **true**, error rate 0.18 → **0.002** |

**Incident opened:** INC-0001, SEV2, "checkout-api health checks failing after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0", status open. The summary documents the failing version, the partial-failure-then-retry sequence, and the recovered state.

Two things worth flagging:
- **v2.3.1 should not be redeployed** without investigation — it failed in all three regions. `v2.3.1-rc` is likewise marked unhealthy in staging, which suggests the problem predates the production rollout.
- No change-manager approval was needed here: the policy applies to deploying a version never healthy in production, and v2.3.0 has a prior healthy production record.

The incident creation call timed out at 30s even though the write succeeded — worth watching, since a caller without the idempotency key would have created a duplicate.
